auth_allow_self_registration.label: Allow User Self-Registration
auth_allow_self_registration.description: Allow users to create accounts via Home Assistant OAuth.

base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.description:
The (base) URL to reach this webserver in the network. 
The default "auto" automatically resolves to the server's primary IP address and the configured port at startup. 
Override this in advanced scenarios where for example you're running the webserver behind a reverse proxy.

bind_port.label: [%key:common::config_entries::bind_port::label%]
bind_port.description: The TCP port to run the webserver.

webserver_warn.label:
Please note that the webserver is by default unencrypted. Never ever expose the webserver directly to the internet! 

Enable SSL below or use a reverse proxy or VPN to secure access. 

As an alternative, consider using the Remote Access feature which secures access to your Music Assistant instance without the need to expose your webserver directly.

ssl_inactive_warn.label:
SSL/TLS is enabled, but the certificate could not be loaded, so the webserver is still running unencrypted. 

Check the certificate and private key below and use the Verify button to test them. The webserver switches to HTTPS as soon as a valid certificate is saved.

enable_ssl.label: Enable SSL/TLS
enable_ssl.description:
Enable HTTPS by providing an SSL certificate and private key. 
This encrypts all communication with the webserver.

ssl_certificate.label: SSL Certificate
ssl_certificate.description:
Provide your SSL certificate in PEM format. You can either:
- Paste the full contents of your certificate file, or
- Enter an absolute file path (e.g., /ssl/fullchain.pem)

This should include the full certificate chain if applicable.
Both RSA and ECDSA certificates are supported.

ssl_private_key.label: SSL Private Key
ssl_private_key.description:
Provide your SSL private key in PEM format. You can either:
- Paste the full contents of your private key file, or
- Enter an absolute file path (e.g., /ssl/privkey.pem)

Both RSA and ECDSA keys are supported. The key must be unencrypted.
This is securely encrypted and stored.

verify_ssl.label: Verify SSL Certificate
verify_ssl.description: Test your certificate and private key to verify they are valid and match each other.

bind_ip.label: [%key:common::config_entries::bind_ip::label%]
bind_ip.description:
Bind the (web)server to this specific interface. 
Use 0.0.0.0 to bind to all interfaces (both IPv4 and IPv6). 
Set this address for example to a docker-internal network, when you are running a reverse proxy to enhance security and protect outside access to the webinterface and API. 

This is an advanced setting that should normally not be adjusted in regular setups.

manifest.name: Webserver
manifest.description: Configuration of the webserver and API
